title: 第3章 涅盘与重生第4章 规划未来
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
漆黑的月夜，笼罩在繁华似锦的帝京之上。
霓虹闪烁，映照着每个角落，如梦如幻，犹如不夜之都。
这座见证了，大夏千年帝国盛世的帝都。
宛如奇迹般屹立于世界之最，它是世界文明的中心，亦是大夏帝国千年政治文化中心。
黑色的商务汽车，穿梭于宽广国道上急行，四周错落有致，布满琳琅满目的商城，一眼望不到边际。
黑色的汽车里，传来声音：“每次看到帝京景色我都有些厌烦了。”
“如果你厌烦了，我可以跟家主申请，将你调去有山有水的地方”
一阵慵懒悦耳的女声从车里传出。
“别！月姐我开玩笑的，帝京是我的家，我爱死这里的一切了”
身形魁梧的西装大汉，求生欲极强的解释。
这要是被贬到，鸟不拉屎的荒山野林，我这一大家子可怎么活。
车内女子没好气的“切”了一声。
魁梧大汉不由汕汕笑了笑。
这这时车里传来另一个男人的声音：
“月姐，阿贵这张破嘴呀，就是没个把门的，您可千万别往心里去。”
“放心，我没那无聊”。
也莫怪他如此紧张，毕竟与这些大家族打交道，犹如在钢丝上行走，稍有不慎，人家只消一句话，便能让底层之人一生的努力如那绚丽的烟花般，转瞬即逝，化为飞灰。
就接着刚才男子声音传来：“月姐，我们这一次任务，是不是已经暴露了”。
“不错，是我大意了，没有想到林家会被上面如此重视，安排人在其留守。”
被称为月姐的女子道。

她自己也万万没料到，上面不仅安排人守着，还在林家内部安排了成员。
本以为林家已经落魄，林霆夫妇这次遇难，上面不会再过多的关注。
结果超出预料，也不知道大小姐，是否已经做好准备。
“月姐，我们不会有麻烦吧！”
“放心，我们既然能拿到东西，上面没有制止，就已经默许了我的行动。”
不久后商务车停靠在，一座雄伟的古建筑群旁。
众人下了车，望着眼前的古建筑群，心中满是敬畏。
月光洒在古老的建筑上，雕梁画栋间仿佛诉说着往昔的辉煌。
一位面容绝美的女子缓缓下了车，她便是柳月颜。
柳月颜抬头看了看眼前的古建筑群，眼中闪过一丝复杂的神色。
“你们在这里等着。”柳月颜轻声说道，便独自向着建筑群内走去。
柳月颜走进建筑群，周围静谧得可怕，只有她的脚步声在回荡。她穿过长长的回廊，来到一处庭院中央。
只见一位身着华服的女子站在亭子里，眼神淡漠却透着威严。
柳月颜恭敬地行礼，“小姐，事情出了些变故。”
华服女子微微挑眉，“哦？说来听听。”
柳月颜深吸一口气，将林家被上面重视，有人员看守以及内部安插人手之事道出。
华服女子听后，沉默片刻，“无妨，这只是一点小阻碍。”
content_en:
The dark moonlit night shrouded the bustling Imperial Capital.
Neon flashes, reflecting every corner, like a dream, like a city that never sleeps.
This imperial capital has witnessed the prosperity of Daxia's thousand-year empire.
Standing at the top of the world like a miracle, it is the center of world civilization and the political and cultural center of the Great Xia Empire for thousands of years.
The black business car was rushing along the wide national highway, surrounded by a dazzling array of shopping malls that could not be seen at a glance.
A voice came from the black car: "I get a little tired of seeing the scenery in the Imperial Capital every time."
"If you are tired of it, I can apply to the owner of the family to transfer you to a place with mountains and rivers."
A lazy and pleasant female voice came from the car.
"No! Sister Yue, I'm just kidding. Imperial Capital is my home. I love everything here."
A burly man in a suit with a strong desire to survive.
If we were demoted to the barren mountains and forests, how would my whole family survive?
The woman in the car said "cut" angrily.
The burly man couldn't help but smile.
At this moment, another man's voice came from the car:
"Sister Yue, Agui's mouth is full of nonsense. You must not take it to heart."
"Don't worry, I'm not that boring."
No wonder he is so nervous. After all, dealing with these big families is like walking on a tightrope. If you are not careful, just one word can make the life-long efforts of the people at the bottom disappear like brilliant fireworks and turn into ashes.
Then the man's voice came from just now: "Sister Yue, have we been exposed in this mission?"
"Yes, I was careless. I didn't expect that the Lin family would be so valued by the superiors and arrange for people to stay here."
The woman called Sister Yue said.
She herself never expected that not only would the higher-ups arrange for people to guard her, but they would also arrange members from within the Lin family.
I thought that the Lin family was already in dire straits and that the higher-ups would not pay too much attention to the death of Lin Ting and his wife.
The result was beyond expectations, and I don’t know if the eldest lady is ready.
"Sister Yue, we won't be in trouble!"
"Don't worry, since we can get things and there is no stop from above, they have already acquiesced to my actions."
Soon the commercial vehicle parked next to a majestic ancient building complex.
Everyone got out of the car and looked at the ancient buildings in front of them with awe in their hearts.
The moonlight shines on the ancient buildings, and the carved beams and painted buildings seem to tell the glory of the past.
A woman with a beautiful face slowly got out of the car. She was Liu Yueyan.
Liu Yueyan raised her head and looked at the ancient buildings in front of her, a complicated look flashed in her eyes.
"You guys wait here." Liu Yueyan said softly, then walked towards the building complex alone.
Liu Yueyan walked into the building complex. The surroundings were eerily quiet, with only the sound of her footsteps echoing. She walked through the long corridor and came to the center of a courtyard.
I saw a woman in gorgeous clothes standing in the pavilion, her eyes indifferent but full of majesty.
Liu Yueyan saluted respectfully, "Miss, something has happened."
The woman in gorgeous clothes raised her eyebrows slightly, "Oh? Tell me."
Liu Yueyan took a deep breath and told the story of the Lin family being taken seriously by the superiors, being guarded by personnel, and having personnel deployed internally.
After hearing this, the woman in gorgeous clothes was silent for a moment, "It doesn't matter, this is just a small obstacle."
